integrity.critical_source_input: Fonarev--Kuznetsov Theorem 1.1 supplies the dimension-preserving equality of Bialynicki--Birula and Schubert cell counts; Brosnan Theorem 3.5 supplies the integral motivic decomposition by fixed components and positive-weight dimensions.
integrity.proof_status: The claim follows formally from two inspected theorems and additivity for algebraic cell decompositions; no numerical experiment is used.

scientific_limitations: The Chow-motive isomorphism is noncanonical and does not identify multiplication in cohomology or Chow rings.
The statement is over the complex numbers, matching the initiating source.
An in-preparation manuscript cited by the source for the special variety S_2Gr(3,7) was not publicly inspectable.
title: Odd biisotropic symplectic Grassmannians have the same integral Chow motive as an ordinary Grassmannian
